name: Talia Jones

text.vignette: Talia reads small habits the way other people read headlines, and the pattern in tonight's mess is hard to ignore. Either it points to a stash of supplies, or to a day on which the colony will not survive the crisis.

options.find-the-cache: Pick an item deck, hunt through it for any 4 cards you like, keep them in your hand, and shuffle the deck afterwards.
options.foresee-the-crisis: When the next crisis card is flipped, it leaves the game and that round's crisis step is skipped.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #16; Skipping the crisis step also clears the round's face-up crisis, the same way Old Divisions does.
